# id: PG-pg-92-balance-owned-lock-fs
# covers: PG 196 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# variant: pg_formulas on (FormulaScaling), professions written as <prof>_fs
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness 5BEC01D0+ (90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: the game's own chance functions read by the harness `chance` command (no randomness: one read per
# lock control: row 196 only, PGTarget wears shackles owned by PGLockOwner.
#   point, the skill-50 no-gear point read twice): lockpick a Prisoner Cage (196), stealth KO (197) and
#   steal Iron Plates (198) against a neutral dummy (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGTarget) 3 m
#   away, Avarek sneaking; the whole file runs paused (speed 0), so nobody moves or fights. Skills 10/25/50/75/90 without gear, then gear own2/own5/own10/own25/own50/own100/lab50 at 50.
# verify: chance rises with the skill; ownN > none = the chance reads the hooked stat; lab50 = none.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
pg_formulas on ~ formulaScaling=1 hooks=8/8
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek building "Prisoner Cage" dist 4 radius 1000 ~ moved=1
@set TGT spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 40 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${TGT} PGTarget
relation PGTarget 0
give PGTarget "Iron Plates" 2
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
stealth Avarek on
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# An owner is required so these are real locked shackles, not an unowned test item.
@set OWN spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 40 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OWN} PGLockOwner
relation PGLockOwner 0
shackle PGTarget owner PGLockOwner
inv PGTarget
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,10,0,none,s10,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,25,0,none,s25,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,0,none,s50,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 75, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 75
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,75,0,none,s75,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,90,0,none,s90,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,0,none,s50b,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own2 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 2 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=2% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,2,own2,own2,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own5 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 5 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=5% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,5,own5,own5,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own10 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 10 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=10% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,10,own10,own10,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,25,own25,own25,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own50 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,50,own50,own50,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own100 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 100 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=100% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,100,own100,own100,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear lab50 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" labouring 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek labouring ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,50,0,lab50,lab50,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,25,50,own50,s25_own50,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 25, gear own100 ---
setstat Avarek lockpicking 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" lockpicking 100 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=100% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
@set C chance Avarek lockpick PGTarget ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking_fs,25,100,own100,s25_own100,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Avarek off
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Avarek dist 300 ~ moved=1
kill PGTarget
kill PGLockOwner
pg_formulas off
